addr: 2nd Floor, Sai Complex, 114, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Paresh is an awesome soul, and his place remains one of my all-time favourites. I’ve been visiting him for almost 20 years now, and I still love the experience every single time. Even after moving to the NCR and trying every so-called “good” place, nothing comes close to dear Paresh Lamba.
One of my close friend referred me this place. I had gone there in january 2020 and got one suit stitched. The trouser fitting was very comfortable and the whole suit fitting was good. …

Never visit this store if you don't want to spoil your most important event. Very costly but worst stitching. Local dress makers would make better dress. The price is premium but the quality is very bad. I repeat again, visit this store …
